title: AP preseason All-America: received votes
detail: Got 3 votes in the AP preseason All-America voting (first team: Fears Jr., Haugh, Tanner, Mirkovic, Krivas). Source: AP via La Nación, Oct 21.

title: Preseason All-Big Ten Team
detail: Named to the 11-man Preseason All-Big Ten team (a tie in voting) alongside Michigan teammate Trey McKenney; Michigan State’s Jeremy Fears Jr. is Preseason Player of the Year. Source: Big Ten / mgoblue.com, Oct 5.

title: SBL Player of the Month (October)
detail: Named the SBL's Player of the Month for October, the season's first. He came home to BC Luleå this summer with the toughest job going: replacing last season's MVP Gustav Hansson. Sources: sblherr.se (Månadens Spelare, 2026/27), Expressen, Nov 7.
detail_sv: Utsedd till månadens spelare i SBL i oktober, säsongens första. Han värvades hem till BC Luleå i somras med tuffast tänkbara uppdrag: att ersätta förra säsongens MVP Gustav Hansson. Källor: sblherr.se (Månadens Spelare, 2026/27), Expressen, 7 nov.
